name: [🌊] Split The Sea
desc:
🌊 UPDATE PART 4

New obstacles for maps
Double jump is here — upgrade it along with speed!

🔱 Wield the Poseidon Rod and split the sea! Race against the clock to dive into the depths and haul back as much loot as you can before the waves come crashing back together.
🍀 Discover 1000+ possible loot variations — treasure chests, pearls, ancient debris, gems, and more. Collect with your friends and build your hoard!

🦯 HOW DO I SPLIT?

Tap/Click to charge up your rod and tear the ocean apart!

⭐ Remember to join the group and send feedback!
